description.value:
Your battlefield experience has refined your fighting techniques. You learn maneuvers fueled by special dice called Superiority Dice.

Maneuvers. You learn three maneuvers of your choice, and two more at Fighter levels 7, 10, and 15. Many maneuvers enhance an attack; you can use only one maneuver per attack. Each time you learn new maneuvers, you can also replace one maneuver you know with a different one.

Superiority Dice. You have four Superiority Dice, which are d8s. A die is expended when you use it, and you regain all expended dice when you finish a Short or Long Rest. You gain another die at Fighter levels 7 (five) and 15 (six).

Saving Throws. If a maneuver requires a saving throw, its DC equals 8 plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice) and Proficiency Bonus.

Maneuver Options

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.HDv9BcFZ8kS2fjOV]{Ambush}. When you make a Dexterity (Stealth) check or an Initiative roll, you can expend one Superiority Die and add it to the roll, unless you have the Incapacitated condition.

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.DDoZa1CUlsUiwak5]{Bait and Switch}. When you're within 5 feet of a creature on your turn, you can expend one Superiority Die and switch places with it, provided you spend at least 5 feet of movement and it is willing and not Incapacitated. This movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks. Roll the die: until the start of your next turn, you or the other creature (your choice) gains a bonus to AC equal to the number rolled.

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.hb94qYUB3oM4nlLx]{Battle Shout}. As a Bonus Action, you can expend one Superiority Die to shout encouragement to allies within 30 feet of you that can hear you. Until the start of your next turn, each of them adds the Superiority Die to its damage roll the next time it hits with a melee attack. (World of Warcraft)

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.cXbZ78oHlsDxfyTV]{Commander's Strike}. When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks to direct a companion to strike: choose a willing creature that can see or hear you and expend one Superiority Die. It can immediately use its Reaction to make one attack with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike, adding the Superiority Die to the damage roll on a hit.

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.nSFBIocD098JcufF]{Commanding Presence}. When you make a Charisma (Intimidation, Performance, or Persuasion) check, you can expend one Superiority Die and add it to the roll.

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.IPBf1mhRRL2bkGvk]{Demoralizing Shout}. As a Bonus Action, you can expend one Superiority Die to shout and demoralize enemies within 30 feet of you that can hear you. Until the end of your next turn, each of them subtracts the Superiority Die from its damage roll the next time it hits a target other than you with a melee attack. (World of Warcraft)

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.QQNkr8k7P5zuho9W]{Disarming Attack}. When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to try to disarm it, adding the die to the damage roll. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or drop one object of your choice that it is holding, which lands in its space.

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.8AuaQLWccMjMuXx3]{Distracting Strike}. When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to distract it, adding the die to the damage roll. The next attack roll against the target by an attacker other than you has Advantage if it is made before the start of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.v3CPJyTEOo0lpQYT]{Evasive Footwork}. As a Bonus Action, you can expend one Superiority Die and take the Disengage action. You also roll the die and add the number rolled to your AC until the start of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.pjb3xAIZPPsAqFXx]{Feinting Attack}. As a Bonus Action, you can expend one Superiority Die to feint at one creature within 5 feet of you. You have Advantage on your next attack roll against it this turn, and if that attack hits, you add the Superiority Die to its damage roll.

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.a2DQ1I1mFE4TqVXD]{Goading Attack}. When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to goad it into attacking you, adding the die to the damage roll. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have Disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than you until the end of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.J4jPAWIvbWvHoLgH]{Heroic Leap}. As a Bonus Action, you can expend one Superiority Die to jump a number of feet up to your Strength score. Creatures within 5 feet of you when you land make a Strength saving throw, taking Bludgeoning damage equal to the Superiority Die roll on a failure, or half as much on a success. (World of Warcraft)

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.LGLtejlRpvXbUXez]{Lunging Attack}. As a Bonus Action, you can expend one Superiority Die and take the Dash action. If you move at least 5 feet in a straight line immediately before hitting with a melee attack as part of the Attack action this turn, you can add the Superiority Die to the damage roll.

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.UhzAsQWqB1SxbCVC]{Maneuvering Attack}. When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to maneuver one of your comrades into another position, adding the die to the damage roll. Choose a willing creature that can see or hear you: it can use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the target.

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.lECgrmPwf5mfPuRu]{Menacing Attack}. When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to frighten it, adding the die to the damage roll. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition until the end of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.5CPFd2aujkjCGMmu]{Mortal Strike}. When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to keep it from healing, adding the die to the damage roll. The target can't regain Hit Points until the end of your next turn. (World of Warcraft)

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.1gwi0dES39DimdqU]{Parry}. When another creature damages you with a melee attack roll, you can take a Reaction and expend one Superiority Die to reduce the damage by the number rolled plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice).

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.UweHSHQ1uo99cZDu]{Precision Attack}. When you miss with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die, roll it, and add it to the attack roll, possibly causing it to hit.

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.BI6IByjkWV8ZUyUN]{Pushing Attack}. When you hit a creature with an attack roll using a weapon or an Unarmed Strike, you can expend one Superiority Die to drive it back, adding the die to the damage roll. If the target is Large or smaller, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet directly away from you.

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.CJVgkJxOY5JH6XYp]{Rally}. As a Bonus Action, you can expend one Superiority Die to bolster the resolve of a companion: choose an ally within 30 feet of you who can see or hear you. It gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the Superiority Die roll plus half your Fighter level (round down).

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.9cwTrFCLMi7eLgpj]{Riposte}. When a creature misses you with a melee attack roll, you can take a Reaction and expend one Superiority Die to make a melee attack roll with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike against it. If you hit, you add the Superiority Die to the damage.

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.zTW8f61Ao1RKZQzo]{Sweeping Attack}. When you hit a creature with a melee attack roll using a weapon or an Unarmed Strike, you can expend one Superiority Die to damage another creature within 5 feet of the original target and within your reach. If the original attack roll would hit the second creature, it takes damage equal to the number you roll on the Superiority Die, of the same type as the original attack's.

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.lIGPsGnpIhpcqf6Y]{Tactical Assessment}. When you make an Intelligence (History or Investigation) check or a Wisdom (Insight) check, you can expend one Superiority Die and add it to the check.

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.Up6EBiQHPh3Hak91]{Trip Attack}. When you hit a creature with an attack roll using a weapon or an Unarmed Strike, you can expend one Superiority Die and add it to the damage roll. If the target is Large or smaller, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have the Prone condition.

Foundry Note

The uses are your Superiority Dice; each maneuver you learn is an item whose activity spends one. The save DC uses the higher of your Strength and Dexterity modifiers.
